tools.name: jerrycan_design
tools.description: Turn requirements into a validated design.json. The agent authors the design; this tool enforces specificity: call without a draft to get the design template, call with a draft to validate it — violations return pointed questions (not code), a complete draft is written to design.json and echoed with design_path. Call repeatedly until status=complete.

requirements.description: What the backend must do, in natural language.

draft.description: A structured design draft conforming to design-schema.json. The tool validates it deterministically: violations come back as pointed questions; a complete draft is written to disk and returned with design_path. Omit on a first exploratory call to receive the design template.

answers.description: Answers to a previous call's questions, keyed by question id.

revision_of.description: Path to an existing design.json being revised.

design_path.description: Filesystem path where the validated design.json was written. Present whenever status is complete; scaffold consumes it as design_path.

tools.name: jerrycan_scaffold
tools.description: Create a new app workspace from a complete design.json: app/ shell, shared/ crate, one route-module crate per design module.

directory.description: Target directory for the new workspace.

tools.name: jerrycan_generate
tools.description: Incremental generator (Angular-style): add a route module, subroute, or dependency to an existing app. Regenerates mounting and workspace members deterministically.

design_slice.description: The design.json fragment for the new unit.

directory.description: App workspace root. Defaults to the MCP server's working directory.

tools.name: jerrycan_gen_tests
tools.description: Generate the failing acceptance test suite for a module from its design slice — one test per endpoint and error case. TDD: run before implementing handlers.

directory.description: App workspace root. Defaults to the MCP server's working directory.

tools.name: jerrycan_check
tools.description: The verification gate: build + clippy(deny) + cargo-audit + cargo-deny + tests + jerrycan lints. Scope to one module for fast iteration. Diagnostics are machine-readable with doc links.

no_fail_fast.description: Run every test target and return per-module pass/fail counts (test_modules) instead of stopping at the first failing target. For TDD red→green visibility.

directory.description: App workspace root. Defaults to the MCP server's working directory.

test_modules.description: Present only under no_fail_fast: per-target (cargo package) pass/fail counts.

tools.name: jerrycan_package
tools.description: Produce hardened deploy artifacts (+ CycloneDX SBOM). Refuses to run unless the full-workspace check is green.

directory.description: App workspace root. Defaults to the MCP server's working directory.

tools.name: jerrycan_docs_search
tools.description: Search the AI-native docs. Returns page+anchor+snippet hits.

tools.name: jerrycan_docs_get
tools.description: Fetch one docs page (optionally one anchored section) as markdown. Pages follow a fixed shape: Purpose, Signature, Minimal example, Variations, Errors you'll hit, Anti-patterns.

tools.name: jerrycan_list_routes
tools.description: The live route tree of the current app: method, path, owning module, handler. The resume-work map for agents.

directory.description: App workspace root. Defaults to the MCP server's working directory.

tools.name: jerrycan_schema
tools.description: Derive the data contract from the app's module migrations: the schema.json shape (tables, columns, foreign keys, unique constraints, indexes, enums) with design-declared field types overlaid. The reviewable, never-hand-written source of truth for the data layer. Each foreign key carries an `enforced` flag: true = a real database FOREIGN KEY (same-module); false = an indexed but application-enforced cross-module relation whose `on_delete` is honored by handlers, NOT the database. Governed by https://jerrycan.cc/schemas/db-schema-v1.json.

directory.description: App workspace root. Defaults to the MCP server's working directory.
